extracted.intended_audience: Agency executives and managers responsible for implementing OMB Circular A-44 (e.g., Inspector General, Executive Director/Comptroller, Deputy Directors, Directors of Finance, Information Processing Board, Office of Programming/Planning/Budgeting)
extracted.subtask_description: Requirements and implementation guidance for preparing an agency's consolidated annual Management Review and Improvement Report under OMB Circular A-44, including content for eight report sections and assignment of responsibilities within the agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation of overall responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall responsibility for coordination of an Agency's management review and improvement program must be delegated to a top-level official reporting directly to the Department or Agency Head.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The requirement suggests assigning the responsibility to either the Inspector General or the Executive Director-Comptroller; an early decision is necessary to assign responsibility and prepare implementing instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidated single report (eight sections)
rubrics_metrics.description: OMB Circular A-44 establishes 'one report' consolidating multiple prior reporting requirements; in practice this is eight reports submitted at one time (Sections I–VIII).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Circular consolidates requirements from previous Circular A-44, Reports Reduction, Financial Management Improvement Program, and ADP accomplishments and improvements; agencies should prepare a single consolidated submission covering all sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section I — Management Reviews (content)
rubrics_metrics.description: A summary report which includes description of the procedures utilized by the Agency to conduct management reviews; review plans for the upcoming current year; and a report of the accomplishments and achievements of the review program for the past fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Given the Inspector General's missions and scheduled reviews, the IG is the logical office to assume responsibility for Sections I (and II).

rubrics_metrics.name: Section II — Priority Improvement Projects (content)
rubrics_metrics.description: A report of the projects under way or to be undertaken to improve a Government operation or program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Responsibility for this section is logically assigned to the Inspector General given their role in management review functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section III — Financial Accomplishments and Plans (content)
rubrics_metrics.description: A summary report similar to the current financial management improvement report, covering financial accomplishments and plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director of Finance (Director of Finance/Financial Management office) is currently responsible for preparing the Financial Management and Improvement Report and can retain responsibility for Section III.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section IV — Automatic Data Processing (ADP) Improvements (content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Two-part coverage: (1) improvements in the performance level of programs or activities resulting from the use of ADP; and (2) significant improvements in the management of computer facilities and resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Information Processing Board is the logical body to prepare the ADP Improvement Report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section V — Management of Federal Reports / Reports Reduction (content)
rubrics_metrics.description: A report of the Agency's efforts to reduce costs of reporting (management of federal reports).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If limited to administrative management reports, the DDS is a logical home for this report; if substantive intelligence/operations reports are included, each Deputy Director should report accomplishments in his Directorate for consolidation by the Office of Programming, Planning, and Budgeting or the IG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section VI — Productivity Improvements (content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers plans for the current year as well as achievements in the past year by program, project, or function regarding productivity improvements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Productivity measurement and reporting should be assigned to each Deputy Director for their own Directorates, who should report accomplishments within that area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section VII — Cost Reductions (content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishment of cost reduction and savings goals for the upcoming current year and those achieved during the past year together with a report on the disposition (e.g., reprogramming or returning to the reserve) of savings achieved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Under the Agency's management philosophy, responsibility for cost reductions is that of the respective Deputy Director.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section VIII — Nominations for Presidential Management Improvement Awards (content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Nominations and related documentation for the Presidential Management Improvement Awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consolidation of nominations can be handled by the Director of Personnel, but nominations must be made by each Deputy Director.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignment of section preparation responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Agency must decide which internal offices/bodies will prepare each section of the consolidated A-44 report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Suggested allocations in the memo: IG for Sections I & II; Director of Finance for Section III; Information Processing Board for Section IV; DDS for Section V (administrative); Deputy Directors for Sections VI & VII; Director of Personnel to consolidate Section VIII. Once the Head decides, either the IG or Office of Programming, Planning, and Budgeting can prepare implementing instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision on scope of Reports Reduction content (administrative vs substantive)
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine whether Section V will include only administrative management reports or also substantive intelligence and operations reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If substantive reports are included, each Deputy Director should report accomplishments in his Directorate for consolidation by Office of Programming, Planning, and Budgeting or the IG; otherwise DDS can handle the administrative reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use and modification of existing agency systems to respond
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies should leverage existing systems (Program Review, IG Surveys, DCI Annual Conference with Deputies, Deputies Meetings, etc.) to respond to the Circular; implementation may require development of modifications and improvements to those systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These will be discussed with Deputies before implementation; suggestions and recommendations are invited from program offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing / reporting deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: The first report under this Circular is due in OMB by September 1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implementing instructions should be issued promptly to meet the deadline.
